title: BIPOLAR: Polarization-based granular framework for LLM bias evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis of model outputs for symmetrical, synthetic statements regarding the Russia-Ukraine conflict, comparing sentiment scores when the subject is Russia versus when it is Ukraine.
Measuring shifts in sentiment scores and bias patterns when prompts are presented in different languages (English, Russian, and Ukrainian).
Evaluating changes in sentiment when the model is prompted to adopt the persona of a citizen from one of the conflicting nations (e.g., "as a citizen of Russia").
